Create a clean HD Chinese Taoist chibi RPG hero WALK animation sprite sheet. The image just shown is the exact accepted character identity and art reference. Preserve this same boy's face and outfit, not a newly designed hero. Identity locks: very short cropped dark brown spiky hair with SMALL tidy silhouette; broad PLAIN gold cloth headband wrapping across the forehead with a large tied bow on his character-left side, NO decorative forehead clasp or emblem; HUGE circular warm amber eyes, round cheeks, tiny cheerful open smile; very large round head and short stocky 2.5-head-high child proportions; ivory wrap shirt, loose short ivory trousers; jade green short open sleeveless coat with narrow antique-gold edges and delicate gold scrollwork mainly along bottom hem; teal sash; teal and gold low cloth shoes with ivory toe caps. Keep the same golden double-gourd bottle with black-white yin-yang medallion and small RED tassel on a belt at character-left hip so walking arms can swing. The gourd and headband bow are permanent asymmetrical accessories, fixed at the SAME anatomical left side in EVERY frame; never mirror an animation pose, never teleport the gourd across the body. Keep the gourd held closely at the left side with the left hand throughout if needed. His hair must remain short and his plain gold forehead band clearly visible, avoid tall wild anime bangs. NO redesign, NO hat, NO long hair, NO sword. DIRECTION SOUTHEAST: all four poses face diagonally toward the viewer AND to screen RIGHT, a FRONT three-quarter view (45 degrees right from frontal). Nose points down-right. Both eyes visible with one narrower; FRONT of ivory shirt and jade coat visible. Feet point diagonally down-right. The face is angled 45 degrees toward screen-right but we still see BOTH eyes. Do not make a side profile. Headband bow and gourd stay toward the screen-right contour in every cell. A true alternating grounded WALK IN PLACE, not running, not a turntable and not repeated static standing portraits. Exact 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal square invisible cells, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. The four poses MUST have different leg silhouettes, a complete walk cycle: TOP LEFT: left leg swings forward in a long stride, right leg extends backward. TOP RIGHT: both legs pass close together under pelvis, left foot planted and right heel lifted behind. BOTTOM LEFT: right leg swings forward in a long stride, left leg extends backward, the inverse leg arrangement of top left but NEVER mirror the head/body/accessories. BOTTOM RIGHT: legs pass close together under pelvis, right foot planted and left heel lifted behind, inverse weight from top right. Return to top left for a seamless cycle. Two contact poses plus two narrow passing poses, not four versions of one long stride. Animate lower legs visibly and correctly. Compact realistic alternating leg motion, small opposite arm swing; sleeves, short coat hems and headband tails move subtly. Keep identical face, short hair and all clothing details across four frames. View from slightly above for a 2D RPG, same camera distance and standing-equivalent anatomical scale throughout. Crisp beautifully painted miniature detail, smooth controlled shading, clean sharp silhouette, do not make pixel art. Every whole body occupies only central 65%–70% width AND height of each cell. Fixed subject center x=50%, tallest hair y=17%, shared grounded foot line y=84%; generous EMPTY margins on every side. No body part, bow, sleeve, bottle or shoes crosses cell boundaries. Entire subject contained inside each individual cell. Absolutely solid pure #FF00FF background everywhere outside the characters; no floor, no shadow, no background gradients, no sparkles or dust, no text, no labels, no guides, no grid lines. Square artwork. Prioritize exact reference identity and precise animation.
